name: vc3d-agent-render
label: Real data render
alt: Three panels from a recorded agent session on PHerc0139 segment w035: the segment's z coordinate as a gray ramp inside its outline; the middle layer of a 28-layer render of the CT under a 640 pixel window of the segment, a mottled texture of light fibers and dark patches; and the maximum over those 28 layers, a mesh of crossing fibers with a few bright specks.
caption: Real data render: PHerc0139 segment w035 at 9.362 um, from the preview and render tools of a recorded session. CT and mesh geometry, no labels, no ink. Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0.

data.credit: Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0
